notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.
goFirst: strategy-concepts §10 [S17] 'go first with aggressive curve-out decks'; the guide calls Sabo 'an aggressive Straw Hat deck' [SH-SAB] and gives no seat advice of its own (inference).

cardValue: the cost-12 enablers (Saul, Loki) carry the whole board's power [SH-SAB]; Docking Six (+6 cost) turns on Sabo's line but not the Elbaph +3000 [SH-SAB]; Chopper makes an attacker Unblockable with a cost-12 Character out [CARD]. Every number is an inference: the guide gives the direction, not the value.

counterAggression 0.9: the guide's 'Don't trade Life early for nothing, but don't fear dropping to 3 either' [SH-SAB] (Sabo is a 4000 leader at 4-5 Life); inference: the AI's own Life weighs a little less.
faceBias 1.0/1.1/1.15: the plan is to swing wide from T3 [SH-SAB]; inference: more weight on the opponent's Life once the board is out.

mulligan: the sourced rule 'a 1-cost dig and either Saul or a 2-cost Elbaph body' [SH-SAB]. Each card counts once; Usopp is counted as a dig (the guide's keepable hand names 'Nami or Usopp'), so a hand needs a second card for the body piece. The guide gives no seat relaxation.
seed 1/3: 'play' biases on Saul and Loki (cost 12+ on the field by T4; Loki as the enabler when Saul is missing, whether or not his On Play has a target [CARD]).
seed 2: giving DON!! to Sabo when a cost-12 Character is out and 3+ attackers are ready ('giveDonLeader' bias).
seed 4: one 'attackWith' bias per 2-cost Elbaph body: the guide's 'swing wide' [SH-SAB] is a plan for the whole team, so each body that can attack gets the same small bonus.
Citations are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; every bias here has a public condition.

assertions.text: Has a cost-12+ Character (Saul or Loki) on the field by T4 in at least 70% of games.
On a turn with a cost-12+ Character and three or more attackers, gives at least one DON!! to Sabo before attacking in at least 80% of such turns.
With no cost-12+ Character on the field, Loki in hand and 6+ DON!! available, plays Loki in at least 80% of such turns.
Attacks with every eligible 2-cost Elbaph body on turns a cost-12 Character is out, in at least 70% of such turns.
